rule_gaps: a discipline word in the name ('MTB', 'Landevei', 'Terreng', 'Elsykkel') derives facets.type=Bikes, so cycling shoes, bar mitts, forks, handlebars and a battery charger all claim to be bicycles
the brand name 'Enduro' (Enduro Bearings) derives discipline=MTB on every bearing it sells
any inch measurement in a name is read as wheel size — an 11\" messenger bag got wheel=11
apparel words sokker / skotrekk / hansker / bukse / shorts / undertrøye / vest / knevarmere / balaklava / regnbukse do not derive type=Apparel (about 20 rows here), while jakke/trøye/sykkelshorts do
component words innerdrev / ytterdrev / frikrans / eikenippel / skivebrems / dekkinnlegg / tempobøyle derive no type at all

complete bicycles under 'SYKKEL > Sykler > …' and 'Sport og fritid > Sykkel > …' often get no type=Bikes, so the Type filter misses real bikes (Apex 1, FAT TUBBY, FLOW TRG, DBS Allroad, both Cinelli Grusracer rows)
'Kondisjon / Treningssykkel' and 'Kondisjon / Spinningsykkel' (Sporttema) resolve to Bikes — 12 indoor gym trainers sit among the bicycles; the crumb should map to Sport
energibar / energigel / energy shot from bike shops land in Bikes instead of Health
the literal source brand 'Unspecified' is stored and displayed as a brand
notes: Bike components and cycling apparel are broadly classified right; the damage is concentrated in (a) the bike shops' non-cycling stock — packrafting gear, camping tarps/mats/lanterns, a Garmin sleep monitor, watch straps, a Campagnolo corkscrew and a fingerboard toy — inheriting Bikes, (b) 12 indoor exercise bikes classed as bicycles, and (c) derived facets that read discipline and brand words as product type. Also shard-wide but not fixable by patch: 157 of 300 rows have no product image, no row has a rating or any variant wiring, and size suffixes in names ('Hyp-E M', 'Endur 7', 'Sete 130') are unwired everywhere — only the 10 groups above have a visible sibling in this shard.
